Needs changes before merge. This is a safety-tier review.

I read the full diff and the linked issue. I used AGENTS.md from upstream main `97a676e5c2307f7a2bc3c7677d1cbe334df8ef40`.

**Requested before merge**

1. **[P1] Compare the picks and slot endpoints in the same frame.** `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:2402` passes model-frame picks to `slot_picked_ends` after the WCS yaw transform. `operation/wcs_yaw.rs:352` rotates the slot endpoints but does not rotate the picks. A valid pick can select the wrong end without a refusal.

   I reproduced this with the PR's application fixture: `a=(-15,0)`, `b=(15,0)`, width/tool diameter 6 mm, and a start pick at `b`. With WCS yaw 180 degrees about the origin, generation succeeds but the first descent is at `(-15,0)`. The requested start is `(15,0)`. With WCS yaw 90 degrees, the same valid pick is refused as 15 mm from the path, beyond the 9 mm reach.

   Carry the picks into the same frame as the endpoints before the comparison, or make the end choice before that transform. Keep the stored model coordinates. Add regression tests for start and exit picks under 90-degree and 180-degree WCS yaw. This blocks merge because the generated path can start at the wrong end.

2. **Give the required reason for the two new test binaries.** `crates/app/tests/slot_start_exit.rs:1` and `crates/motion/tests/slot_start_exit.rs:1` add top-level integration binaries. The PR body lists their tests but gives no reason for separate binaries. Current AGENTS.md, “New tests join a directory suite,” requires that reason. Put the tests in existing domain suites, or add the required one-line reason for each binary to the body.

**Local build and tests**

I used `.claude/worktrees/review-3978`. Trial merge `e08fbdf9a247f9fc0d11c9024adb42a5922d68c4` merges the reviewed head with the main commit above. Its first parent is the reviewed head. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 305 steps; 304 passed, 1 failed, 0 stalled; 41.3 minutes |
| Motion library | 651 passed, 22 ignored |
| Application library | 310 passed |
| Motion `slot_start_exit` / `slot_round_ends` | 7 / 4 passed |
| Application `slot_start_exit` / `slot_extension` | 6 / 5 passed |
| Application `example_catalog` | 43 passed, 4 ignored |
| Application `example_catalog_adaptive` / `example_catalog_edge_work` | 1 / 1 passed |
| Application `golden_cl` / `solid_law_goldens` | 34 / 7 passed |
| UI library, from `crates/ui` | 1642 passed, 7 failed, 8 ignored; both new slot tests passed |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | All 11 light tests passed across five test steps |
| Light build retry | Passed; 1 step, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

The initial light build failed in `sccache` with `Too many open files (os error 24)`. The shell file limit was 256. I reran its failed build step with `ulimit -n 8192`, `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`, and an empty `RUSTC_WRAPPER`. It passed. This required no source change.

The quick gate's one failed step was the UI library. I ran the same suite on bare upstream main in this worktree. It failed the same seven tests: 1640 passed, 7 failed, 8 ignored. These are pre-existing host failures, not additional blockers from this PR. Tracking issue: none found for these seven failures.

```
egui_app::report_tests::a_kind_button_asks_the_shell_for_the_whole_window
egui_app::report_tests::no_answer_copies_nothing
egui_app::report_tests::the_answer_copies_the_picture_and_says_the_word
egui_app::report_tests::the_door_opens_the_window_and_a_kind_button_files_the_url
egui_app::report_tests::the_picture_is_still_copied_after_the_window_is_closed
egui_app::report_tests::the_title_field_travels_into_the_url
egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds
```

The report tests give this error:

```
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
```

The headless test also reports no graphics adapter. I restored the trial-merge branch after the baseline check.

**Extra suites run**

I ran the full application `start_exit_shared` suite: 4 passed. The catalog and golden suites named above ran by name in the quick gate. The fixture and importer additions to test selection do not apply: this diff changes no fixture or importer.

**Mutations rerun by the reviewer**

| Mutation | RED | GREEN after restoration |
|---|---|---|
| Remove the end swap: return `(a,b)` | 3 motion tests failed: start, exit, and both picks | All 7 motion tests passed |
| Disable the incompatible-exit refusal | `both_picks_hold_or_the_exit_is_refused_by_name` failed | All 7 motion tests passed |

The two temporary WCS probes also failed as described in finding 1. I removed those probes and reran the original application slot suite: all 6 tests passed. All temporary changes are restored. The worktree has no source changes.

**Other checks**

- Goldens moved: none. No recorded `.nc`, `.cl`, catalog program, fixture, or snapshot PNG changed.
- The body has before/after UI images. The images are outside the PR diff.
- The row-parity hand trace agrees with the planner for one, two, and three rows, in both cutting directions.
- The full heavy lanes did not run, as current upstream AGENTS.md requires for this review.
- Non-blocking file-size note: `generate.rs` already exceeds 400 lines and grows by one line in this diff.

I kept the review worktree and branch to preserve the build cache.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Slot picks now rotate with the endpoints in the temporary WCS generation parameters. Stored model coordinates stay unchanged.
   Pins: `the_start_pick_holds_under_90_degree_wcs_yaw`, `the_start_pick_holds_under_180_degree_wcs_yaw`, `the_exit_pick_holds_under_90_degree_wcs_yaw`, and `the_exit_pick_holds_under_180_degree_wcs_yaw`.
   Each pin covers zero and translated WCS origins. Each checks stored coordinates.
   All four failed without the fix and passed after restoration. The full application slot suite passed all 10 tests.
2. The PR body now gives one reason for each new application and motion `slot_start_exit` integration binary.

Head: `933847f5b8faa90fa93223c13ae1e6e5d22c98eb`.
Quick: 302 of 303 steps passed. The UI library repeats the seven graphics-adapter failures from the review baseline.
Heavy: 105 of 106 steps passed. The known #3886 pocket failure repeats the counts `(4688, 4660, 1980)`.
Clippy passed for app, motion, and UI. Light passed all 6 steps and 11 tests.
Catalog and reached goldens passed. No recorded programs changed.
The body gives commands, mutation proof, build recovery, and current upstream plan checks.

Please re-review this head.

Clean. This is a safety-tier re-review. I am an independent reviewer. I am not the worker that wrote the change.

I used AGENTS.md from upstream main `d80dc6944f912171a06029f635e0450c505d44a9`. Trial merge `3ad129912ec21ad6473f41ea0d9cb96dbdef380b` merges the head with that main. Its first parent is the head. The merge had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used. This host has a graphics adapter.

**Earlier findings (review of `c94dbe366`)**

1. **[P1] Picks and slot ends in different frames: fixed.** Commit `933847f5b` rotates `picks.start` and `picks.exit` with `a` and `b` in `rotate_params` (`crates/app/src/operation/wcs_yaw.rs:352`). The rotation changes only the temporary generation parameters. `SavedS` keeps the stored model-frame parameters. The Trochoidal Slot arm keeps its earlier transform. Four new pins cover a start pick and an exit pick at 90 and 180 degrees, each with a zero and a translated work offset. Each pin also checks that the stored ends and picks do not change. I removed the pick rotation: all four pins failed. I restored it: all four passed.
2. **Reason for each new test binary: fixed.** The body gives one reason for `crates/app/tests/slot_start_exit.rs` and one for `crates/motion/tests/slot_start_exit.rs`.

**New blockers:** none.

**Local build and tests**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 306 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 48.4 minutes |
| UI library (in the quick gate) | Passed. The seven graphics-adapter failures of the earlier review do not occur on this host |
| Application `slot_start_exit` | 10 passed |
| Motion `slot_start_exit` | 7 passed |
| Application `start_exit_shared`, `slot_extension` | Passed |
| Application `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` | Passed |
| Application `golden_cl`, `solid_law`, `solid_law_goldens`; motion `solid_law` | Passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

**Extra suites run**

The catalog and golden suites above ran by name in the quick gate. The fixture and importer rules do not apply: the diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no import code.

**Mutations rerun by the reviewer**

| Mutation | RED | GREEN after restoration |
|---|---|---|
| Remove the pick rotation in `wcs_yaw.rs` | 4 of 10 application tests failed: the four WCS yaw pins | 10 of 10 passed |
| Remove the end swap in `slot_picks.rs` | 3 of 7 motion tests failed: start, exit, and both picks | 7 of 7 passed |

The worktree has no source changes after the restoration.

**Heavy lanes**

I did not run the heavy lanes. Heavy lanes are not a merge condition. The author's record on this head is in the PR body: 106 steps, 105 passed, 1 failed. The failed test is `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`, with the counts `(4688, 4660, 1980)`. Issue #3886 records the same failure on main. The fix commit changes only the Slot arm of the WCS yaw transform.

**Goldens moved:** none. `git diff --stat upstream/main...933847f5b -- "*.nc" "*.cl" examples/catalog testdata` is empty.

**UI:** The body has before and after images from the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The fix commit does not change UI code.

**Optional, non-blocking**

- Under a WCS yaw, a pick refusal from `slot_picked_ends` (reach, tie or impossible exit) prints the pick and the slot ends in the rotated generation frame. `exit_err` maps the location of an error but not the coordinates in the message text. The refusal is still correct. Only the numbers in the message differ from the model frame. Suggested follow-up: P7.

A maintainer will merge.

Left for the maintainer: the head `933847f5` is covered by a `pr-reviewer` marker set by the PR author's own account — no counted independent review — and the diff touches slot toolpath generation (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/`). Safety-tier.
